cases.name: read-vcpkg-update-deny-other-port-not-applicable
cases.note: The request names only the port 'zlib' (§manager-vcpkg). The ports that 'upgrade --no-dry-run' rebuilds beside it, such as ports that depend on it, are not package names of the request, so a Deny rule naming the port 'libpng' does not apply even where libpng depends on zlib: a Deny rule protects a port only from requests that name it. Neighbour: read-vcpkg-update-packages-same-deny.

cases.name: read-vcpkg-update-no-packages-allow

cases.name: read-powershell-update-allow-except-other-manager
